baseline_justifications: Matching 'links that expression (e.g., a pronoun) to the earlier entity.' This is a qualitative definition; judged on substance. Bohnet et al. 2023 is a coreference resolution system, and resolving anaphoric referring expressions (pronouns) to their antecedent entity mentions is the core coreference task. OntoNotes/CoNLL-2012 data it uses includes conversational (telephone/broadcast) turns, so cross-turn pronoun-to-entity linking is squarely within its scope.

Matching 'resolves ... a referring expression (e.g., a pronoun), linking that expression to the earlier entity.' This qualitative definition is exactly anaphora/coreference resolution. Bohnet et al. 2023 is a coreference resolution system (seq2seq transition-based, T5-based, evaluated on OntoNotes/CoNLL-2012) whose core function is linking pronouns and other referring expressions to their earlier antecedents across sentences.
